description: Solver classification [skills/scene-simulation/SKILL.md 'Solver Classification']: the physical target of each object (simulation_class) and the Blender systems preferred for it. An object contract whose blender_system is not preferred for its simulation_class must record solver_choice_reason (reason and evidence); bin/spec_audit.py checks it and the gate lists it under solver_deviations. world_spec.schema.json repeats these names as enums; tests/test_schemas.py keeps them equal.

rigid_body.target: Impact, collapse, rolling, stacking, finite fragments

fixed.target: Static environment no solver moves (plain collider or PASSIVE rigid body)

kinematic.target: Keyed motion (keyframes or ANIMATED rigid body), not solver-owned
